# pe-xor-decoder.exe

Inert synthetic x86 PE for the instruction-guided XOR string extraction test.
It contains a tiny XOR decoder, a 21-byte key and encrypted API-name/example-URL
strings, with no imported APIs. Never execute fixtures.

Generated by stng's `pe_xor::tests::fixture` through:

```
STNG_XOR_FIXTURE_OUT=/path/to/pe-xor-decoder.exe cargo test --lib pe_xor::tests::benchmark_prefilter_and_recovery -- --ignored
```

The filefacts test verifies that decoded content passes through the PE text view,
retains ciphertext/key provenance through a cache snapshot, and does not invent
imports. Build the test against the stng checkout implementing PE XOR recovery
using Cargo's command-line git-source patch; no local manifest override is needed.
